facts.text: Under the Wisconsin Tuition Promise at UWL, resident undergraduates with family adjusted gross incomes of $55,000 or less receive last-dollar tuition and fee funding for up to four years.

sources.title: Wisconsin Tuition Promise - Financial Aid | UW-La Crosse
sources.quote: The program is structured to provide “last dollar” financial support after federal and state grant aid and tuition scholarships are accounted for.

sources.title: Wisconsin Tuition Promise - Financial Aid | UW-La Crosse
sources.quote: Undergraduate students (new first–year and transfer students) with family Adjusted Gross Incomes (AGI) ≤ $55,000 who first enroll at participating UW schools in fall 2025 or spring 2026 will be eligible.
